ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent collaborative learning platform designed for student societies to organize hackathon teams and share local academic resources.
ideas.title: EduVibe AI Peer Mentor Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent architecture inspired by winning student support platforms, making it highly relatable to the organizing clubs at G.L. Bajaj Institute.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and satellite-based land compliance and green space monitoring dashboard tailored for large educational campuses.
ideas.title: Campus GreenPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts sophisticated satellite monitoring mechanics into a localized campus context, appealing directly to institutional judges looking for real-world feasibility.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered meal recommendation and nutritional analyzer tailored specifically to hostel and campus mess menus.
ideas.title: SmartMess Nutrition & Wellness Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable daily problem for college students with a polished frontend and localized dataset.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven trust and customer acquisition platform designed to help local craftsmen pitch and market their products digitally.
ideas.title: LocalArtisan Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on societal impact and feasibility—two core judging criteria explicitly stated in the Ideathon guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics tool utilizing regression models to forecast campus infrastructure maintenance failures and safety incidents.
ideas.title: CampusIncident AI Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering and statistical rigor through predictive modeling, which stands out in an idea-focused competition.
